content:
传统的热交换器在处理高粘度流体、高固体浆料和腐蚀性介质时经常会由于快速结垢和堵塞而发生故障。宽间隙焊接板式换热器（WGPHE）具有抗堵塞性能优良、传热效率高、压力损失低、耐腐蚀、耐磨等显着的技术优势。

本文分析了WGPHE在铝、制糖、制浆造纸、化工废水处理行业的应用，阐述了宽流道结构如何作为保证工艺连续性和传热效率的核心支撑。

1.氧化铝行业：解决拜耳工艺中的侵蚀和结垢问题

氧化铝生产是现代冶金工业的基石，其主流工艺拜耳法是一个涉及高温、高压、强碱和大量悬浮固体颗粒的复杂化学过程。其中，沉淀过程（Precipitation）是决定产品质量和产量的核心环节，也是换热设备运行维护挑战最严峻的领域之一。

** 1.1 沉淀阶段的过程特点 **在沉淀罐中，需要稀释的铝酸钠溶液在受控温度下沉淀三水铝石晶体。这个过程伴随着大量的热量释放，需要精确的温度控制来调节晶体的生长速率。

缩放比例：

铝酸钠溶液处于过饱和亚稳态。当传热面附近的流体速度降低（形成死区）或温差过大时，铝酸钠和硅酸钠在壁上自发成核并长大成硬结垢。该结垢层的导热率极低，不仅严重阻碍传热，而且会不断增厚，最终堵塞流道。

侵蚀：

为了抑制结垢和颗粒沉降，浆料必须保持相对较高的流速。然而，浆料悬浮有高硬度氢氧化铝晶种和铝土矿残渣。在传统换热器中，高速的固液两相流就像“液体喷砂”一样，不断冲刷冲击传热通道的入口、弯管和板片接触区域，导致设备壁厚迅速减薄，甚至穿孔、泄漏。

1.2 上海板换机械设备有限公司 的解决方案

针对上述特点，上海板换机械设备有限公司基于多相流体力学研究，开发了沉淀浆液专用WGPHE。

1.2.1 立式宽间隙板式换热器的结构优势

  • 浆料垂直流动，利用自身的动能和浮力使固体颗粒保持悬浮，形成均匀流动。

  • 板片位于垂直通道的两侧，这减少了板片下部波纹中固相的积累，从而不易结垢。

  • 结合碱煮清洗系统，减少换热器的拆卸和清洗频率。

1.2.2 卧式宽间隙板式换热器结构优势

  • 精确的流速控制确保底部流速高于临界悬浮液流速。

  • 改进的板波纹设计不仅促进流体底部湍流的形成，而且减少板上的停滞区。

  • 易于拆卸、清洁和维护。

1.2.3 独特的入口分配器设计

为了解决入口侵蚀问题，上海板换机械设备有限公司 在泥浆入口处开发了一种独特的流体分配器。

  • 能量耗散和流量整流该装置缓冲来自进料管的高速射流，消除局部涡流和高压区。

  • 分布均匀保证浆体进入时沿板片组宽度方向各通道的流量和速度均匀，防止因流量分布不均匀而造成局部高速冲蚀和局部低速结垢并存。

1.2.4 应用案例

在某大型氧化铝厂技改项目中，原来的管壳式冷却器需要每2-3周停机进行高压水清洗，管束使用寿命不足一年。更换为上海板换机械设备有限公司宽间隙沉淀浆料冷却器后，清洗周期延长至3-6个月，大大减少了停机时间和清洗废液的产生。由于结垢率大幅降低，设备平均传热系数（K值）运行周期内保持较高的温度，从而使沉淀罐的温度控制更加精确，直接改善氧化铝产品的粒度分布质量。

2.糖和发酵

** 行业**

：处理高粘度和生物质纤维

生物质加工面临双重挑战：生物纤维堵塞接触点，粘度在浓缩过程中呈指数级上升。 2.1 制糖业：来自 Bagacillo 和高粘度糖浆的挑战 在蔗糖生产过程中，压榨的混合汁中含有大量的 Bagacillo，这会导致： - 纤维污垢/纤维挂起：传统板式换热器的波纹接触点充当“纤维陷阱”。一旦纤维被捕获，它们就会迅速积聚并形成致密的纤维垫，阻止流体流动。

  • 高粘度层流：糖汁在多效蒸发器中浓缩成糖浆或糖蜜，其粘度可达数千厘泊。在管式换热器中，这种高粘度流体往往会形成层流，在管壁附近形成极厚的热边界层，并显着降低传热效率。 上海板换机械设备有限公司 的解决方案 - “S” 型畅通流道：上海板换机械设备有限公司 的 WGPHE 采用特殊的板片设计，具有光滑、波浪状的通道横截面，没有尖锐的突起和死区。

20-30毫米的超宽间隙可以让长纤维顺利通过。 - 低雷诺数湍流：即使在仅 0.2–0.3 m/s 的低速度下，板表面的鱼鳞图案也会产生二次流，例如糖浆中的迪恩涡流。这种强烈的流体混合增强了传热并防止糖因局部过热而焦糖化。

  • 余热梯级利用：由于热效率高，上海板换机械设备有限公司设备可以利用来自末效蒸发器的低温废蒸汽（仅60-70℃）来预热原汁，充分回收原本排放的余热，大大减少新鲜蒸汽的消耗。 2.2 燃料乙醇：麦芽浆冷却和生物污染 乙醇发酵麦芽浆是一种复杂的浆液，含有谷物残渣、酵母细胞、蛋白质和未发酵的淀粉。 - 生物污垢在适当的温度下，有机物质很容易在传热表面上形成生物膜。

这层薄膜具有极高的耐热性，非常难以清洗，甚至会对不锈钢造成腐蚀。 - 非牛顿流体特性Mash 通常表现为剪切稀化流体。在传统设备中，速度分布不均匀会导致局部粘度过高和停滞，形成“死区”。 上海板换机械设备有限公司 的解决方案 - 无清洁死区：全焊接结构提供光滑的内表面。

原位清洗 (CIP) 系统的高速酸碱清洗液可以冲刷所有表面，无死角，彻底去除生物膜并防止细菌生长。 - 流变优化：针对非牛顿流体修改通道设计，确保流道内剪切速率分布均匀，避免局部高粘度区域，保证麦芽浆均匀冷却。

3.纸浆和造纸

** 行业**

：从白水中回收热量

造纸工业通常是能源密集型和水密集型的。降低吨纸能耗的关键在于回收生产过程中产生的白水和黑液的热量。 3.1 造纸机白水：纤维和填料的混合物 白水从造纸机网部排出，含有细纤维素纤维、填料和化学添加剂。传统热交换器极易发生纤维沉积和结垢，因此造纸厂通常不敢回收白水中的低品位热量（45-55℃）。

3.2 上海板换机械设备有限公司的解决方案 枕式板式换热器是通过激光焊接两块金属板，然后进行液压成形，在表面形成规则的“枕状”突起，具有周期性膨胀和收缩的流动截面。流体在通过变截面通道时，速度周期性变化，产生局部加速和减速，产生自紊流效应。宽通道结构为纤维提供了畅通无阻的物理空间，而变截面通道引起的速度波动和湍流混合。横截面使纤维始终保持悬浮和翻滚，几乎不可能粘附和沉积。

3.3 应用案例

4.环境工程

** 应用**

化学废水（例如农药、染料和药品废水）通常具有高盐度 (TDS)、高 COD（化学需氧量）和强腐蚀性的特点。 - 抗结晶、抗沉淀：高盐废水蒸发浓缩时容易析出结晶盐。WGPHE的宽通道允许晶体颗粒通过，而高流量冲刷可防止通道堵塞。对于含油污泥废水，较宽的间隙可以避免污泥的架桥和堆积。

  • 经济性：与石墨换热器或特殊材料管壳式换热器相比，WGPHE具有更高的传热系数，并且需要更少的传热面积。因此，当使用哈氏合金（C-276）或钛钯合金时，总体材料成本更低，性价比更高。

title: 螺旋板式换热器工程、选型与市场趋势指南
excerpt: 一篇重新撰写的螺旋板式换热器技术指南，覆盖起源、结构、焊接、成型、工业选型、竞争格局和中国市场趋势。
author: HeatEx Direct 编辑团队
reviewer: HeatEx Direct 编辑团队
content:
螺旋板式换热器看起来并不复杂：两张长金属板围绕中心卷制，形成两条相互隔离的螺旋通道。一侧流体从中心进入并向外流动，另一侧则按相反方向通过。最终形成的是一种紧凑的逆流换热器，其流动形态很难被传统管式设备完全复制。

这种几何结构解释了为什么螺旋板技术在近百年后仍然有价值。它尤其适合处理脏污、高黏度、含颗粒或易结垢介质。但同样因为结构特殊，制造质量也变得非常关键：一台螺旋板式换热器的可靠性，取决于成型、间距、焊接、密封和检验能否稳定受控。

从发明到工业平台

现代螺旋板式换热器通常可追溯到 20 世纪早期的瑞典 Rosenblad 技术体系。其早期价值主张很清楚：用紧凑设备替代笨重换热器，在提供强逆流传热的同时，更好地适应部分管束设备难处理的复杂介质。

后续的工业化过程，把螺旋板从一个巧妙几何结构变成了可重复制造的压力容器产品。随着时间推移，设备从早期不可拆、清洗困难的形式，逐步发展出更可维护的结构、更丰富的材料、更自动化的成型工艺，以及更受控的焊接方法。

螺旋流道为什么不同

在螺旋板换热器中，两侧通常各自沿一条连续通道流动。这不同于多根并联管束或窄板片通道，因为后者在介质含固体或黏度波动时更容易出现分配不均和死区。

弯曲通道会诱导二次流和壁面剪切。对清洁液体而言，这会强化传热；对易结垢流体而言，它还有助于保持颗粒悬浮，降低沉积物在低速区域堆积的倾向。这也是螺旋板常被用于炼油重质物料、浆液冷却、结晶液、废水浓缩、制浆造纸和高黏度工艺流体的原因。

制造质量才是核心差异

采购时最重要的问题，并不是供应商能否把两张板卷成螺旋，而是能否稳定重复通道几何、焊缝质量和密封质量。

关键制造因素包括：

  • 通道间距：细小偏差也可能造成流速不均、局部结垢或压降异常。
  • 定距柱或支撑件焊接：高度、熔深和分布会同时影响强度和流动行为。
  • 边缘成型：平滑、稳定的边缘可以减少死区，并提升密封可靠性。
  • 主焊缝质量：连续、低缺陷焊缝对承压完整性和防止串漏至关重要。
  • 热输入控制：过高热输入会使薄板变形、削弱耐腐蚀性或引入残余应力。

成熟供应商通常会通过自动成型、受控焊接、检验程序和运行数据来降低这些风险。低成本供应商也可能做出可用设备，但采购方应根据工况严苛程度判断，不能把所有螺旋板换热器视为同一等级。

螺旋板与管壳式如何比较

这个问题并不是简单判断谁更先进。管壳式换热器在超高压、清洁介质、维护要求简单或预算敏感场景中仍然很有竞争力。螺旋板式换热器更适合解决结垢、占地、热回收或复杂液体流动问题。

螺旋板的典型优势包括结构紧凑、热效率高、逆流路径长，以及对某些脏污或黏性介质更友好。其典型限制则包括制造要求高、设计更依赖项目工况，以及在极端高压场景下未必能替代重型管式设备。

对很多工厂来说，生命周期成本才是决定因素。螺旋板设备初始采购价可能更高，但如果它能延长清洗周期、减少非计划停机并保持热回收效率，总运行成本反而可能更低。

哪些工况更适合螺旋板

更适合考虑螺旋板的场景包括：

  • 炼油和石化行业中的重质烃类或含固体流体。
  • 制浆造纸及含纤维工艺液。
  • 有结垢倾向的废水和蒸发浓缩工况。
  • 矿物加工浆液与湿法冶金液体。
  • 空间受限的紧凑型热回收项目。
  • 需要焊接结构的贵重或危险介质。

不太适合的场景包括超高压工况、极其清洁且更适合低成本方案的公用工程介质，或压降要求远高于传热强度的流程。

竞争格局与中国市场方向

国际品牌在设计数据、制造流程和服务经验方面有长期积累。它们的优势不只是设备形状，而是可重复生产、材料经验、检验文化和生命周期支持的组合。

中国制造商则经历了从早期仿制、标准化到本土化生产和部分高端应用突破的过程。当前市场呈现明显分层：高端项目更看重项目业绩和质量体系，风险较低的应用则常常更关注价格和交期。

对中国供应商而言，下一阶段更可能依赖专业化，而不是广泛模仿。更稳固的竞争力来自聚焦少数细分工况、建立真实测试数据、提升焊接自动化、记录全生命周期表现，并把服务能力延伸到设备交付之后。

采购 询价应包含什么

询价螺旋板换热器时，不应只提供流量和进出口温度。更有价值的询价资料 还应说明结垢机理、固含量、粒径、黏度曲线、腐蚀性组分、清洗方式、允许压降、目标运行周期、检验要求和材料偏好。

采购方还应要求供应商解释通道间距选择、焊缝检验、机械清洗通道、压力容器规范符合性以及相近项目业绩。这些回答往往比低报价更能反映真实能力。

小结

螺旋板式换热器不是所有换热场景的通用替代品。它更像是一种专用工具，适用于紧凑逆流传热、脏污介质适应性和长周期运行都很重要的工况。

成功项目不会只把螺旋板看成一个设备外形，而会把它作为完整工程系统评估：流动行为、焊接、成型、清洗、材料选择和服务支持必须一起判断。当这些条件匹配时，螺旋板换热器可以解决传统设备只能通过放大尺寸、频繁清洗或牺牲热回收来勉强处理的问题。

title: Spiral Plate Heat Exchangers: Engineering, Selection, and Market Trends
excerpt: A rewritten technical guide to spiral plate heat exchangers, covering origin, structure, welding, forming, industrial selection, competitive landscape, and China market trends.
author: HeatEx Direct Editorial Team
reviewer: HeatEx Direct Editorial Team
content:
Spiral plate heat exchangers look deceptively simple. Two long metal sheets are wound around a center, creating two separate spiral channels. One fluid enters from the center and moves outward, while the other follows the opposite path. The result is a compact counterflow heat exchanger with a flow pattern that is difficult for conventional tubular equipment to reproduce.

That geometry explains why the technology has remained relevant for nearly a century. It is especially useful when the fluid is dirty, viscous, particle-laden, or prone to fouling. Yet the same geometry also makes manufacturing quality critical: a spiral plate heat exchanger is only as good as its forming, spacing, welding, sealing, and inspection discipline.

From Invention to Industrial Platform

The modern spiral plate heat exchanger concept is commonly traced to the early twentieth century and the Rosenblad design tradition in Sweden. Its early value proposition was direct: replace bulky equipment with a compact exchanger that could provide strong counterflow heat transfer and tolerate difficult process media better than many tube bundles.

The later industrialization of the technology turned the spiral plate from a clever geometry into a repeatable pressure-vessel product. Over time, the equipment evolved from fixed, harder-to-clean units toward more maintainable designs, improved materials, automated forming, and more controlled welding methods.

Why Spiral Flow Performs Differently

In a spiral plate exchanger, each side generally follows one continuous channel. This is different from equipment with many parallel tubes or narrow plate passages, where maldistribution and dead zones can appear if the fluid contains solids or has unstable viscosity.

The curved channel produces secondary flow and wall shear. For clean liquids, that improves heat transfer. For fouling-prone streams, it can also help keep particles suspended and reduce the tendency for deposits to build up in quiet regions. This is the reason spiral plate units are often considered for refinery bottoms, slurry cooling, crystallizing liquids, wastewater concentration, pulp and paper streams, and high-viscosity process fluids.

Manufacturing Quality Is the Real Differentiator

The most important buying question is not whether a supplier can roll two plates into a spiral. It is whether the supplier can repeat the geometry, welds, and sealing quality consistently.

Key manufacturing factors include:

  • Channel spacing: small variation can create uneven velocity, local fouling, or pressure drop surprises.
  • Stud or spacer welding: spacer height, weld penetration, and distribution affect both strength and flow behavior.
  • Edge forming: smooth, consistent edges reduce dead zones and support reliable sealing.
  • Main weld quality: continuous, low-defect welds are essential for pressure integrity and cross-contamination control.
  • Heat input control: excessive heat can distort thin plate, damage corrosion resistance, or create residual stress.

Advanced suppliers use automated forming, controlled welding, inspection programs, and operating data to reduce these risks. Lower-cost suppliers may still produce usable equipment, but buyers should examine the application severity before treating all spiral plate exchangers as equivalent.

Spiral Plate Versus Shell-and-Tube

The comparison is not about declaring one technology universally better. Shell-and-tube exchangers remain strong choices for very high pressure, very clean service, simple maintenance expectations, or cost-sensitive duties. Spiral plate exchangers are more compelling when the process problem is fouling, footprint, heat recovery, or difficult liquids.

Typical spiral plate advantages include compact layout, high thermal effectiveness, a long counterflow path, and better tolerance of certain dirty or viscous streams. Typical limitations include more demanding fabrication, project-specific design work, and pressure ranges that may not match heavy tubular equipment in extreme services.

For many plants, the lifecycle economics are decisive. A spiral plate unit may cost more at purchase, but if it extends cleaning intervals, reduces unplanned shutdowns, and preserves heat recovery performance, the total operating cost can be lower.

Where Spiral Plate Heat Exchangers Fit Best

Strong candidate services include:

  • Refinery and petrochemical streams with heavy hydrocarbons or suspended solids.
  • Pulp, paper, and fiber-containing process liquids.
  • Wastewater and evaporation duties with scaling tendency.
  • Mineral processing slurry and hydrometallurgical liquids.
  • Compact heat recovery projects where space is limited.
  • Valuable or hazardous media where welded construction is preferred.

Less suitable cases include ultra-high-pressure duties, very clean utility fluids where a simpler exchanger is cheaper, or processes where extremely low pressure drop is more important than heat transfer intensity.

Competitive Landscape and China Market Direction

International brands have accumulated decades of design data, manufacturing routines, and service knowledge. Their strength is not only equipment geometry; it is the combination of repeatable production, materials experience, inspection culture, and lifecycle support.

Chinese manufacturers have moved from early imitation and standardization toward broader domestic production and selected high-end applications. The market now shows a familiar split: premium projects tend to value proven references and quality systems, while lower-risk duties often prioritize price and delivery speed.

For Chinese suppliers, the next stage is likely to depend on specialization rather than broad imitation. Stronger positions can come from mastering a narrow set of duties, building real test data, improving welding automation, documenting lifecycle performance, and offering service beyond the initial equipment sale.

Quote Request Checklist for Buyers

When requesting a spiral plate exchanger quotation, include more than flow rate and inlet/outlet temperatures. A useful quote request should also describe fouling mechanism, solids content, particle size, viscosity curve, corrosive species, cleaning method, allowable pressure drop, operating cycle target, inspection requirements, and material preferences.

Ask suppliers to explain channel gap selection, weld inspection, mechanical cleaning access, pressure vessel code compliance, and comparable references. These answers will reveal more than a low initial price.

Takeaway

Spiral plate heat exchangers are not general-purpose replacements for every heat exchanger. They are specialized tools for duties where compact counterflow heat transfer, dirty-fluid tolerance, and long operating cycles matter.

The best projects treat spiral plate technology as an engineered system: flow behavior, welding, forming, cleaning, material selection, and service support must be evaluated together. When those pieces align, the spiral plate exchanger can solve problems that conventional equipment only manages through oversizing, frequent cleaning, or lost heat recovery.

title: Juyuan Plate-Frame Welded Heat Exchanger Guide for Process Duties
excerpt: A process-duty guide to Juyuan plate-frame welded heat exchangers, covering welded integrity, compact design, API 662 or ASME expectations, and maintenance checks.
author: Siping Juyuan Hanyang Plate Heat Exchanger Co., Ltd.
reviewer: Siping Juyuan Hanyang Plate Heat Exchanger Co., Ltd.
content:
Juyuan plate-frame welded heat exchangers are designed for industrial process duties where compact heat transfer, welded integrity, and adaptability to special media are important. The equipment combines plate-type thermal performance with a welded structure that reduces reliance on elastomer gaskets in demanding services.

Why Plate-Frame Welding Matters

Conventional gasketed plate heat exchangers are efficient and maintainable, but gasket limits can become important under higher temperature, aggressive media, or leakage-sensitive conditions. A welded plate-frame design helps extend the application window while preserving a compact footprint.

For process plants, this can be valuable when space is limited, heat recovery is important, or conventional shell-and-tube equipment would require a larger alloy inventory.

Standards and Project Requirements

Projects may require API 662, ASME, or other pressure-vessel and heat exchanger expectations depending on industry and jurisdiction. These requirements affect design review, materials, welding procedure qualification, non-destructive testing, pressure testing, and documentation.

The project specification should clearly define design pressure, design temperature, corrosion allowance, material grade, inspection class, gasket or seal boundaries, and cleaning expectations.

Operation and Maintenance

Even when the heat transfer core is welded, maintenance planning remains necessary. Operators need isolation points, drain and vent arrangements, pressure-drop monitoring, and a cleaning strategy. If the process fluid can foul or polymerize, the exchanger should be reviewed for access and cleaning compatibility before purchase.

Baseline commissioning data is also important. Recording pressure drop, inlet and outlet temperatures, flow rate, and duty after startup gives the plant a reference for future troubleshooting.

Buyer Takeaway

Plate-frame welded heat exchangers fit best where compactness and welded integrity are both required. The strongest procurement approach treats the exchanger as a pressure-containing process asset, not only a thermal calculation. Standards, inspection, cleaning, and lifecycle access should be reviewed together.

excerpt: A technical guide to Juyuan welded wide-channel plate heat exchangers for particle, fiber, viscous, and serviceable industrial duties.
author: Siping Juyuan Hanyang Plate Heat Exchanger Co., Ltd.
reviewer: Siping Juyuan Hanyang Plate Heat Exchanger Co., Ltd.
content:
Siping Juyuan builds welded heat exchange products around new technologies, processes, and structures. Among them, welded wide-channel plate heat exchangers are designed for duties where conventional narrow plate passages may foul, block, or become difficult to clean.

Application Window

Wide-channel welded plate equipment is most relevant when the process stream contains solid particles, fibers, suspended matter, or high-viscosity fluid. Typical applications may include chemical, metallurgical, biomass, food and beverage, seawater desalination, power, and central heating processes where compact heat transfer is still desirable.

The engineering tradeoff is clear: the channel must be open enough to pass difficult media, but the plate geometry still needs enough turbulence and surface renewal to keep heat transfer effective.

Welded Structure and Service Access

Juyuan welded wide-channel designs emphasize welded plate packs and serviceable structures. For difficult media, service access is not a minor detail. If solids accumulate or process conditions change, operators need a practical way to inspect, wash, or mechanically clean the equipment.

This is where welded wide-channel designs differ from many compact exchangers. They aim to reduce leakage risk from gaskets while preserving enough access for maintenance and cleaning.

Buyer Checks

When specifying this type of exchanger, buyers should provide solids content, particle size, fiber behavior, viscosity curve, allowable pressure drop, cleaning method, corrosion data, and operating cycle target. These details affect channel width, plate pattern, material, flow velocity, and nozzle arrangement.

The supplier proposal should explain welding quality control, pressure testing, inspection scope, mechanical cleaning access, and how the design avoids stagnant zones. For severe services, comparable references are more useful than generic performance claims.

Practical Takeaway

Welded wide-channel plate heat exchangers are best understood as reliability-focused compact exchangers. They are not selected only for high heat transfer coefficient; they are selected when a plant needs heat transfer to remain stable in the presence of solids, fibers, viscosity, or fouling pressure.

title: 巨元板框式焊接换热器过程工况指南

content:
巨元板框式焊接换热器面向需要紧凑传热、焊接完整性和特殊介质适应性的工业过程工况。该类设备把板式设备的热工性能与焊接结构结合起来，在严苛工况中减少对弹性密封垫的依赖。

为什么采用板框式焊接结构

常规可拆板式换热器效率高、维护方便，但在较高温度、腐蚀性介质或泄漏敏感场景中，垫片限制会变得突出。板框式焊接设计有助于扩大适用窗口，同时保持相对紧凑的设备占地。

对过程工厂而言，当现场空间有限、热回收价值较高，或传统管壳式设备需要更多合金材料时，这类结构具有工程意义。

标准与项目要求

根据行业和项目所在地，设备可能需要满足 API 662、ASME 或其他压力容器与换热器要求。这些要求会影响设计审查、材料、焊接工艺评定、无损检测、压力试验和文件交付。

项目技术规格应明确设计压力、设计温度、腐蚀裕量、材料牌号、检验等级、密封边界和清洗要求。

运行与维护

即便传热核心采用焊接结构，维护规划仍然不可忽视。运行人员需要隔离点、排放和放空布置、压降监测和清洗策略。如果过程介质可能结垢、聚合或沉积，采购前就应核查设备的清洗可达性和清洗兼容性。

基准调试数据也很重要。开车后记录压降、进出口温度、流量和换热量，可以为后续故障排查提供参考。

采购启示

板框式焊接换热器适合同时需要紧凑性和焊接完整性的场景。成熟采购方式应把设备视为承压过程资产，而不仅是热工计算结果。标准、检验、清洗和生命周期维护通道需要一起评估。

四平巨元以全新技术、工艺和结构的全焊接换热产品为载体，面向多行业提供个性化、专业化解决方案。其中，焊接宽通道板式换热器主要面向常规窄通道板式设备容易结垢、堵塞或清洗困难的工况。

适用窗口

宽通道焊接板式设备更适合处理含固体颗粒、纤维悬浮物或高黏度流体的过程介质。相关应用可覆盖化工、冶金、生物质能、食品饮料、海水淡化、电力和集中供热等场景，这些工况往往既要求一定通道通过能力，也希望保持板式设备的紧凑传热优势。

工程取舍在于：通道要足够开阔，以便复杂介质通过；板型又要能提供必要的扰动和壁面更新，避免传热效率过快衰减。

焊接结构与维护通道

巨元焊接宽通道设计强调焊接板束和可维护结构。对复杂介质而言，维护通道不是附加项。如果固体沉积、介质波动或运行周期拉长，操作人员需要有实际可用的检查、冲洗或机械清洗方式。

这也是焊接宽通道方案与许多紧凑换热器的区别：它希望减少垫片泄漏风险，同时保留足够的维护和清洗可达性。

采购核查点

选型时，采购方应提供固含量、颗粒尺寸、纤维形态、黏度曲线、允许压降、清洗方式、腐蚀数据和目标运行周期。这些信息会影响通道宽度、板型、材料、流速和接管布置。

供应商方案应说明焊接质量控制、压力试验、检验范围、机械清洗可达性，以及如何避免滞流和沉积区域。对于严苛工况，相似项目经验比笼统性能承诺更有参考价值。

小结

焊接宽通道板式换热器可以理解为强调可靠性的紧凑换热设备。它的选择依据不只是更高传热系数，而是在含固体、纤维、高黏度或易结垢介质中，让传热性能尽可能保持稳定。

title: Siping ViEX Heat Exchanger Unit Automatic Control Engineering Guide
excerpt: An engineering guide to ViEX heat exchanger units, focusing on integrated station packages, automatic control, variable flow operation, and buyer checks.
author: Siping ViEX Heat Exchange Equipment Co., Ltd.
reviewer: Siping ViEX Heat Exchange Equipment Co., Ltd.
content:
Siping ViEX heat exchanger units combine the heat exchanger, circulating pump, make-up pump, and control system into a complete station package. The goal is to turn heat exchange from a collection of separate components into an integrated operating unit for heating, air conditioning, and domestic hot water systems.

Why Integration Matters

In district heating and building utility systems, the heat exchanger is only one part of the station. Pumps, valves, sensors, control cabinets, make-up water, and communication interfaces determine whether the station can maintain stable supply temperature and pressure under changing demand.

An integrated unit reduces field assembly work and gives the supplier more control over hydraulic matching. This is useful when projects need repeatable station layouts, predictable commissioning, and clear maintenance responsibility.

Control Functions

ViEX heat exchanger units support temperature regulation, variable flow regulation, combined temperature and flow regulation, automatic field control, and unattended remote communication control. These functions are important because heat demand is not constant through the day or season.

Variable-frequency pumps can adjust secondary-network flow, while control valves can regulate the primary network according to secondary supply temperature and outdoor temperature signals. The purpose is to avoid excessive flow, reduce energy use, and keep user-side temperature stable.

Engineering Checks

For buyers, the key questions are not limited to heat transfer area. The unit should be reviewed for exchanger selection, pump head, valve authority, control logic, sensor placement, pressure protection, water treatment, electrical cabinet layout, and remote communication protocol.

Maintenance access also matters. Operators should be able to isolate the exchanger, service pumps, check filters, verify instruments, and troubleshoot controls without dismantling the whole station.

Practical Takeaway

A heat exchanger unit is most valuable when thermal design and controls are treated together. For heating and HVAC projects, the best result comes from matching the exchanger, pump, valve, and control strategy to the actual load profile rather than sizing each component in isolation.

title: Siping ViEX Spiral Plate Heat Exchanger Guide for Fouling Services
excerpt: A technical guide to ViEX spiral plate heat exchangers for viscous, dirty, and particle-laden liquid duties.
author: Siping ViEX Heat Exchange Equipment Co., Ltd.
reviewer: Siping ViEX Heat Exchange Equipment Co., Ltd.
content:
Siping ViEX spiral plate heat exchangers are suited to liquid duties where continuous flow paths, compact heat transfer, and fouling tolerance matter. The spiral geometry creates two separated curved channels, allowing fluids to exchange heat over a long counterflow path within a compact footprint.

Spiral Flow Advantage

In a spiral plate exchanger, each side generally follows one main channel rather than a large bundle of parallel small passages. This can help reduce maldistribution and dead zones when the process stream contains suspended solids, viscosity variation, or fouling tendency.

The curved path also promotes secondary flow and wall shear. For dirty liquids, this can support more stable operation by reducing quiet regions where deposits would otherwise build up.

Suitable Duties

Spiral plate exchangers are often considered for wastewater, slurry cooling, heavy organic liquids, viscous process streams, heat recovery, and applications where cleaning interval matters. They are not a universal replacement for shell-and-tube equipment, but they can be a strong fit when compactness and dirty-fluid tolerance are both required.

Material and welding quality remain central. Corrosion, abrasion, temperature cycling, and pressure duty must all be reflected in plate thickness, weld inspection, and pressure testing.

Cleaning Strategy

For fouling service, the cleaning strategy should be part of the design. Buyers should clarify whether the unit will use chemical cleaning, flushing, removable covers, or mechanical access. The selected approach affects channel width, nozzle layout, drainage, and operating limits.

Operating discipline is equally important. Stable flow velocity, controlled startup, and proper filtration can extend the operating cycle between cleanings.

Buyer Takeaway

ViEX spiral plate heat exchangers should be evaluated by more than heat duty. A strong specification describes the fluid solids, viscosity, corrosive species, allowable pressure drop, cleaning method, and target run length. Those details determine whether the spiral geometry can deliver its full lifecycle value.

title: 四平维克斯换热机组自动控制工程指南
excerpt: 解析四平维克斯换热机组的一体化站房配置、自动控制、变流量运行和采购评估要点。
author: 四平维克斯换热设备有限公司
reviewer: 四平维克斯换热设备有限公司
content:
四平维克斯换热机组把换热器、循环水泵、补水泵和控制系统集成为一体，用于实现自动化、高效、节能换热，并完成热力站功能。这类设备适用于供暖、空调和生活热水系统，热源可为蒸汽或高温热水。

为什么要做成机组

在集中供热和建筑公用工程系统中，换热器只是热力站的一部分。水泵、阀门、传感器、控制柜、补水系统和通信接口共同决定了站房能否在负荷变化时保持稳定供水温度和压力。

一体化机组可以减少现场装配工作，并让供应商更好地完成水力匹配。对于需要标准化站房布置、可预测调试过程和清晰维护边界的项目，这种成套交付方式更有优势。

控制功能

维克斯换热机组支持温度调节、变流量调节、温度与流量联合调节、全自动现场控制以及无人值守远程通信控制。这些功能很重要，因为供热或空调负荷会随昼夜和季节变化。

变频水泵可调节二次网流量，调节阀可根据二次网供水温度和室外温度信号控制一次网流量。其目标是在避免过量循环的同时降低能耗，并保持用户侧温度稳定。

工程核查点

采购方不能只看换热面积。完整机组还应核查换热器选型、水泵扬程、阀门权威度、控制逻辑、传感器布点、压力保护、水处理要求、电控柜布置和远程通信协议。

维护空间同样关键。运行人员应能在不拆解整套设备的情况下隔离换热器、检修水泵、检查过滤器、校验仪表并排查控制故障。

小结

换热机组的价值来自热工设计和控制策略的协同。对供热与暖通项目而言，理想方案不是孤立放大每个设备，而是根据真实负荷曲线匹配换热器、水泵、阀门和控制方式。

author: 四平维克斯换热设备有限公司

content:
四平维克斯螺旋板式换热器适用于重视连续流道、紧凑传热和一定抗结垢能力的液体工况。螺旋结构形成两条相互隔离的弯曲通道，使冷热流体能够在紧凑空间内沿较长逆流路径换热。

螺旋流道优势

在螺旋板式换热器中，两侧介质通常各自沿一条主通道流动，而不是分配到大量并联小通道中。当过程流体含有悬浮固体、黏度波动或结垢倾向时，这种结构有助于减少分配不均和死区。

弯曲流道还会形成二次流和壁面剪切。对脏污液体而言，这有助于减少沉积物在低速区域堆积，从而支持更稳定的运行周期。

适用工况

螺旋板式换热器常用于废水、浆料冷却、重质有机液体、高黏度过程流、热回收以及清洗周期重要的应用。它不是所有场景下管壳式设备的替代品，但当项目同时要求紧凑性和对复杂液体的适应性时，螺旋板结构具有优势。

材料和焊接质量仍然关键。腐蚀、磨蚀、温度循环和压力等级都应体现在板厚、焊缝检验和压力试验要求中。

清洗策略

对易结垢工况而言，清洗策略应成为设计的一部分。采购方应明确设备采用化学清洗、冲洗、可拆盖板还是机械清洗通道。不同方式会影响通道宽度、接管布置、排放方式和运行边界。

运行纪律同样重要。稳定流速、受控开车和合理过滤可以延长两次清洗之间的运行周期。

采购启示

维克斯螺旋板式换热器不能只按换热量评估。成熟规格应说明介质固含量、黏度、腐蚀性组分、允许压降、清洗方法和目标运行周期。这些信息决定螺旋流道能否发挥完整的生命周期价值。
